findings.text: follow-on: the parity index derives `failures=none` from a grep for `^FAILED|^ERROR`, so a chunk whose collection aborts is recorded as a clean pass and counted as one; base chunk_08 ran with the absent new test path in its file list, exited 5 with "no tests ran", and its five present files -- which collect 75 passing tests when the absent path is removed -- were never measured at base, so the instrument reports a green arm over a chunk that collected nothing and the manifest's parity figure is wrong.

follow-on: the baseline_suite note states the base arm "covers 85 of the 86 files", but one absent path aborts the whole ninth chunk rather than only that file, so the base arm covers 80 files and the parity claim is weaker than the record states.

follow-on: the after_suite `command` carries the angle-bracket placeholder `<the ten files listed in the chunk file named on that line>` where the record contract requires the literal command that ran with absolute paths and no placeholder, so the field names no command a reader can re-run.
